description: Traffic volumes at points on the highway is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Alberta | Gouvernement de l'Alberta. Alberta Transportation and Economic Corridors collects traffic volumes on provincial highways. The data is used to identify potential construction activities, maintenance needs and roadway design. Coverage: Government of Alberta. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Alberta | Gouvernement de l'Alberta. Its tags are AADT, ATR, automated traffic recorders, average annual daily traffic, highway control sections. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTML, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-04-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Alberta. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
